name: Social anarchism
summary: Social anarchism is the collectivist, left-wing branch of anarchism. It holds that liberty and solidarity go together, and that the state and capitalism are linked hierarchies to be replaced by common ownership and a bottom-up federation of free associations built on mutual aid. It favours direct action, direct decision-making and means that match its ends, and rejects parties, vanguards and the market.
scope: The mainstream of the family: anarchist communism (Kropotkin) with its collectivist and syndicalist relatives, as framed by Malatesta and by Bookchin's defence of social anarchism against lifestyle anarchism. It excludes individualist anarchism, anarcho-capitalism, primitivism and Marxist state socialism; mutualists and collectivists differ on wages and markets.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Care should be free to all as part of the common stock, but organised through federated communes and cooperatives rather than a state; only exceptions like Chomsky back state provision.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Anarchist communists want the wage system abolished, not a state-set wage floor, though adherents back wage struggles by direct action; inferred.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Kropotkin says capitalist markets put profit above need and cause crises, colonial expansion and war; distribution is by need, not exchange.

public-ownership.rationale: The goal is common ownership run by workers and communes; Kropotkin warns central government plans would fail, so state ownership is not the aim.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Adherents want wealth taken from owners and would accept redistribution toward equality, but they seek expropriation rather than state taxation; inferred.

unions-good.rationale: Kropotkin has workers' own unions take over each industry, and syndicalism is a dominant strand; Malatesta warns against union bureaucracy.

property-fundamental.rationale: Kropotkin calls private appropriation of land and the means of production neither just nor beneficial; it is the root of inequality.

regulate-corporations.rationale: They aim to abolish corporate capitalism rather than regulate it through the state, though breaking up monopolies is favoured; inferred.

cut-welfare.rationale: Social anarchists reject the dependency framing and ground society in mutual aid and need-based sharing, so cutting provision for the needy runs against them.

worker-ownership.rationale: Collective ownership via worker cooperatives and labour syndicates is the standard social anarchist economic form.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Malatesta and others distrust government power and rely on custom and voluntary association, so state surveillance is rejected; inferred from anti-statism.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Malatesta favours curing rather than punishing and treats law and police as a worse remedy than freedom; adults' choices are not for the state to coerce.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Adherents confront racists by direct action but distrust handing the state new coercive powers; contested.

strong-leader.rationale: Social anarchism rejects fixed leadership and hierarchy, and revolutionary vanguards, in favour of flat organisation.

state-harmful.rationale: Bakunin says where there is a State one class dominates another; the state is a coercive hierarchy to be abolished.

limit-guns.rationale: Malatesta praises armed volunteers and an armed people, so state gun control is unwelcome; inferred and contested.

empower-police-military.rationale: Malatesta holds that custom and voluntary defence do better than police, and a people defending itself is invincible; the state's forces are rejected.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Freedom for consenting adults fits the stance against coercive law, though anarcha-feminists are split on prostitution; inferred.

decide-locally.rationale: Kropotkin's ideal is federation of every commune and local group in place of hierarchy from centre to periphery.

rehabilitation.rationale: Kropotkin calls prisons schools for crime and says punishment cannot reduce it; Malatesta wants offenders cured, not avenged.

traditional-family.rationale: Anarchists reject imposed hierarchy including patriarchal authority in the household, and Goldman attacked marriage; not a bedrock institution for them.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: They support equality and sexual freedom, though many would abolish state-sanctioned marriage altogether; inferred.

abortion-legal.rationale: Anarcha-feminism and bodily autonomy favour a woman's own choice, though anarchists would remove state control of the matter either way; inferred.

more-religion-public.rationale: Bakunin rejected God as absolute master and anarchists are anticlerical; religion should not shape public power.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Solidarity and equality are central, so adherents back social action against racial hierarchy; the method would be direct and communal, not state policy.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Anarcha-feminists treat gender hierarchy as social rather than natural, and Kropotkin holds character is formed by conditions; inferred.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism denies borders special sanctity, so national preservation is not a goal; inferred.

gradual-change.rationale: Bookchin insists on social revolution, and Malatesta wants private property and government abolished by revolutionary action rather than by gradual reform.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism treats borders as lacking sanctity, so restricting movement is opposed.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Federation across frontiers is wanted, but bodies like the UN are state structures; Kropotkin's delegates are not rulers.

free-trade.rationale: Kropotkin sees the world market as driving capitalist expansion and war, so free trade is not a social good; it is no answer to exploitation.

nation-first.rationale: Kropotkin attacks rivalries between nations over markets and favours federation across national frontiers.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Adherents distrust state militaries but have backed volunteer solidarity such as in Spain; contested and inferred.

open-borders.rationale: Cosmopolitanism and a stateless world imply borders are illegitimate; inferred from SEP's account of anarchist cosmopolitanism.

limit-growth.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology blames capitalist commodity relations, so many adherents oppose endless growth, though he is pro-technology; inferred.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Bookchin locates ecological destruction in capitalism, so drastic change is wanted, though by social revolution rather than government; inferred.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Bookchin values liberating technology but says social relations of capital and hierarchy are the root problem, so technology alone will not do it.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Social ecology is hostile to centralised, corporate-run technology; inferred.

revolution-justified.rationale: Malatesta calls for revolution to abolish government and property, and Bookchin demands social revolution.

experts-over-public.rationale: Malatesta separates administration from government, rejects delegation of power, and wants people to organise their own affairs.

central-planning.rationale: Kropotkin argues central government plans would fail and production should be run by workers' own organisations.

socialized-markets.rationale: Mutualists and collectivists keep exchange with labour vouchers or compensation, while communists reject markets; the strands are split.

land-value-tax.rationale: A state-collected tax is a reform inside the existing order and does not abolish landlordism; inferred.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Abolishing private appropriation of wealth implies ending inherited fortunes; heavy taxation is a state tool but the direction fits; inferred.

basic-income.rationale: Kropotkin wants free access to the common stock, not payments from a state; inferred.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Kropotkin sees national economic rivalry and markets as sources of conflict, and tariffs are state economic management.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Kropotkin rejects central government plans and wants production run by workers' organisations.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Social anarchists favour common ownership; only mutualists keep a form of private property.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Kropotkin's communism abolishes wages, though mutualists and collectivists keep labour compensation.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Banking would be abolished but not for the market, which social anarchists reject; the statement's premise fails; inferred.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised bodies fixing wages preserve the state and wage system, both of which anarchists abolish.

one-party-rule.rationale: Social anarchists reject the party model and vanguards, and the state itself.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Hereditary rule is a plain case of the domination social anarchists reject.

democracy-best.rationale: Bookchin says a free society will be democratic, while Kropotkin and Malatesta reject majority rule and elected government; adherents are split.

direct-votes.rationale: Popular assemblies and participatory decision-making are favoured, though Malatesta and consensus advocates distrust counting numbers.

workers-councils.rationale: Kropotkin has workers' organisations running production and a federation of communes in place of government; councils fit that.

right-to-secede.rationale: Voluntary free federation implies a group may decline to join or leave; inferred from Kropotkin's federation.

natural-rulers.rationale: Malatesta rejects delegated power and the claim that anyone is entitled to rule.

political-violence-never.rationale: Malatesta calls violence a necessary evil against a regime born of violence and Goldman defended reactive violence, though pacifist strands exist.

war-builds-character.rationale: Kropotkin treats war as a product of capitalist rivalry, not a source of virtue.

separate-church-state.rationale: Anarchists are anticlerical and would abolish the state, so keeping religion from public power fits, though they go further.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Anarchists reject law itself and Kropotkin says morality is independent of and anterior to law and religion.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Anarcho-capitalism is rejected by anarchists because it is not anti-capitalist; they want defence by free association.

military-superiority.rationale: Anarchists are anti-militarist and want armies replaced by volunteer popular defence.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism and anti-statism leave no place for ethnically defined states.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Bookchin stresses class relations and Bakunin class domination, but Kropotkin gives mutual aid a large role; not the sole driver.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Distribution by need and the pursuit of equality favour equal well-being, though not identical rewards.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Decentralised self-governing communities and anti-statism favour local authority; not a core topic, so inferred.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Kropotkin criticises colonial expansion as a capitalist outgrowth; reparations by states are a secondary inference.

civilizational-union.rationale: Anarchists reject nation building and state unification, though cultural federation could be accepted; inferred.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Kropotkin grounds morality in mutual aid and solidarity rather than competition.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Malatesta makes freedom and solidarity complementary, but a ranking of duty over rights is not the anarchist framing; inferred.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology treats ecology as central, though he grounds it in society; inferred.

limit-population.rationale: Kropotkin attributes poverty to institutions, so coercive population limits are not the answer; inferred.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Bookchin rejects primitivism and blames capitalist commodity relations, not technology or civilization, for ecological harm.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Bookchin sees technology as liberating but conditional on social change; disruption for its own sake is not a goal; inferred.

human-enhancement.rationale: Freedom for individuals to choose how to live fits, but anarchism has no settled view on the question; inferred.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Malatesta rejects delegating power to any governing body and prefers decisions by people themselves.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Distrust of state power implies support for private communication; not directly addressed, so inferred.

restore-past-order.rationale: Anarchists aim at a new society of voluntary federation, not a return to an old order.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Bookchin demands programmatically coherent organisation tied to principles, but adherents also value practical results; inferred.

direct-action.rationale: Social anarchists favour direct action and reject elections and representatives.

means-match-ends.rationale: Prefigurative politics: a free society must be built by free methods.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Bookchin explicitly rejects anti-technology primitivism and says reason and technology can free people from toil.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Kropotkin wants integrated labour in which manual and intellectual work are joined and no group is permanently managers.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Kropotkin: each draws from the common stock to the fullest extent of their needs.

production-for-use.rationale: Kropotkin criticises capitalism for putting profit above community needs and wants production to serve need.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Kropotkin holds private appropriation of the means of production lets owners live off workers who must accept wages under necessity.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Social anarchists call the dictatorship of the proletariat elitist and deny that the state will wither away.

collective-farming.rationale: Agricultural communes are named among the favoured collective forms, though small family farms are not ruled out in some strands.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Kropotkin argues industry must seek markets abroad and competition pushes states into war.

taxation-theft.rationale: Anarchists see the state as coercive but their property critique runs the other way, so the libertarian theft framing is not theirs.

harm-principle.rationale: Malatesta holds liberty is limited by others' freedom and society may defend itself, but anarchists deny the state any right to restrict; split.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Bookchin prefers social freedom and says individuality is formed socially, and Malatesta makes freedom complementary.

conscription.rationale: Malatesta prefers volunteer formations over conscripts or mercenaries and opposes compelled service.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Anarchists reject both state voting and the idea that exit is enough; they stress direct participation; inferred.

state-as-business.rationale: Anarchists reject the state and the profit logic of business alike.

positive-liberty.rationale: Malatesta says freedom is complemented by others' freedom and Kropotkin wants material well-being for all as the base of liberty.

media-academia-power.rationale: Social anarchists locate power in capital and the state, not primarily in media and universities; inferred.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Kropotkin holds character and ability are shaped by conditions and anarchism denies natural hierarchy.

organic-representation.rationale: Kropotkin says representative government corresponds to capital rule; delegates, not rulers, carry mandates.

total-state.rationale: The state is the opposite of social anarchist aims.

national-rebirth.rationale: Anarchists reject nationalism and the state-led mobilisation it implies.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Kropotkin condemns colonial expansion and wars driven by competing states.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Domination by lords over followers is the hierarchy that anarchism opposes.

bound-labor.rationale: Kropotkin opposes private appropriation of land and any coerced labour.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Bookchin defends reason and criticises relativist currents in anarchism, though adherents see knowledge as shaped by power too; inferred.

universal-morality.rationale: Kropotkin says morality is independent of and anterior to law and religion, rooted in mutual aid, and Bookchin defends reason; contested.

single-common-good.rationale: Malatesta stresses free initiative and free compact among differing groups rather than one imposed good; inferred.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Anarchists reject states and nationalism generally, so a right to a national state is denied; inferred.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Citizenship as a state grant is not something anarchists endorse as a right, though freedom of movement is; inferred.

revive-national-language.rationale: Anarchists have no interest in language-based state building; low as unaddressed.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Worker self-management through cooperatives and syndicates is central.

school-vouchers.rationale: Malatesta wants education by free discussion and practice, not state vouchers for market schools; inferred.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: State fiscal policy is not a concern of a stateless ideology and adherents have no common view.

economic-freedom.rationale: Kropotkin ties government to capital, so freedom requires ending economic domination, but not in the market sense; inferred.

rule-by-example.rationale: Malatesta rejects rulers, though he prizes custom and example over police; as a theory of government it is not accepted.

national-self-determination.rationale: Self-governing communities yes, but nation-states not; Anarchists favour federation over national statehood; inferred.

force-without-un.rationale: Malatesta opposes state militaries and war; unilateral force abroad is rejected.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Bookchin values reason and secularism, though not at the expense of care and solidarity.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism rejects citizenship-based exclusion from mutual aid.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Kropotkin wants access to the common stock by need, not conditional on state compulsion, though he expects voluntary contribution.

class-collaboration.rationale: Capital and labour are opposed in the wage system anarchism seeks to abolish.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Bookchin defends cultural and rational heritage and rejects hostility to civilization.

dominated-front.rationale: Anarchists oppose imperialism but not by uniting states against others; inferred.

workers-nation.rationale: Kropotkin favours free federation across national frontiers and workers' international organisation.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Equality and anti-hierarchy rule out legislated gender roles.

ban-interest.rationale: Proudhon's mutualism opposed interest via free credit, but legal bans by a state are not favoured by the rest; inferred.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Equality central; laws enforcing hierarchy are the state's coercion.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Bakunin: where there is a state one class dominates another; Kropotkin ties government to class division.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Social ecology opposes capital-driven ecological destruction; inferred.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Cosmopolitanism and anti-statism leave no ground for compelled national assimilation.

elite-replacement.rationale: Bookchin and anarchists attribute social ills to capital and hierarchy, not conspiratorial replacement.

proportional-representation.rationale: Malatesta rejects elections as a path to freedom; a fairer parliament is still a parliament.

national-mission.rationale: Kropotkin condemns national rivalries and expansion.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Anarcha-feminism holds male domination is a hierarchy to be abolished; SEP names Goldman.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Kropotkin says representative government corresponds to capital rule, so politicians serve the owning class.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Kropotkin treats crime and character as shaped by social conditions and anarchists oppose coercive state eugenics.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Anarchists condemn state violence, though they distrust courts as remedy; inferred.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Social anarchists reject both centralised and limited government.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Equality and individual freedom to associate rule it out.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Equality is central and Kropotkin's "all for all", though adherents reject law as the guarantor.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Kropotkin and Malatesta are internationalist, so isolated socialism is unstable; inferred.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Anarchists oppose colonialism and states created by dispossession; inferred.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Anarchists oppose state law generally but also religious law, so adherents have no settled view.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Liberty of belief and rejection of coercive law make bans on conversion unacceptable.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: A state ban on a practice rests on coercive law that anarchists reject.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Anticlerical anarchists oppose religious indoctrination in state schools, though they would prefer free education; inferred.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Social anarchists reject that the state will wither away and deny any state should grow.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Anarchists see order without a social contract and deny authority's legitimacy, though they stress voluntary association; unresolved.

trade-surplus.rationale: Kropotkin sees national competition for markets as a cause of war; mercantilism is not a goal; inferred.

population-transfer.rationale: Equality and anti-statism rule out forced removal of minorities.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Malatesta's revolution crushes owners by force and expropriation is accepted, so this absolutist rule is not theirs.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Kropotkin says cooperation, not competition, drives survival and moral growth.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Anarchists distrust state suppression, though they oppose fascism by direct action; inferred.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Anarchists object to power to command and delegated authority even if unused, which is the core of the non-domination idea.

separated-powers.rationale: It tames the state but preserves it; social anarchists reject limited government as well.

vanguard-party.rationale: Social anarchists act through direct action, not through revolutionary vanguards.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Equality and need-based distribution favour priority for the worst-off, though by social means.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Housing would be common rather than sold into private ownership; Kropotkin opposes private appropriation; inferred.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Kropotkin sees workers' direct organisation as the route to expropriation; the state restricting it is opposed.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Kropotkin attributes social ills to institutions and conditions, not numbers.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Cosmopolitanism and mutual aid across lines go against it.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Anarchists would abolish offices but favour rotation and non-elite selection if any exist; inferred.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Anarchists reject state emergency powers and dictatorship, which Malatesta says offers no safeguard.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: State price fixing keeps the market; communist anarchists seek free distribution instead; inferred.

party-controls-media.rationale: Free initiative and free compact exclude party control of information.

party-commands-army.rationale: Anarchists reject parties and state armies.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Borders and citizenship as state tools lack legitimacy in their cosmopolitanism.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Kropotkin wants delegates, not rulers; if any office exists it should carry no privilege; inferred.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Social anarchists reject the political party model and fixed leadership.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: A supranational state is still a state, though federation across borders is favoured; inferred.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Malatesta rejects delegation of power and state armies.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Anarchists reject hierarchical authority including clerical.

clerical-rule.rationale: Rule by clergy joins state and church hierarchy that Bakunin attacked.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Anarchists are anti-militarist and revolutionary, though Kropotkin famously backed the Allies in 1914 and adherents split; low.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Free initiative and rejection of coercive law exclude moral censorship.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Presidents are not an anarchist institution, and permanent rulers are worse than rotating delegates; inferred.

recall-officials.rationale: Kropotkin wants delegates, not rulers, which implies they remain answerable and removable.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Anarchists are anti-militarist and oppose military blocs and foreign troop deployments.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Housing would be held in common rather than owned by each family; Kropotkin opposes private appropriation, though ending rent fits; inferred.

people-in-arms.rationale: Malatesta argues a people who want to defend themselves are invincible and prefers volunteer formations to professional armies.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Kropotkin favours integrating town and country, not moral hierarchy between them; inferred.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Nation-state unification is not an anarchist aim; inferred.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Kropotkin wants manual and intellectual work integrated and rejects the divide; inferred.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Anarchist cosmopolitanism denies hierarchies between peoples.

death-penalty.rationale: Kropotkin: no punishment, prisons or hangmen can reduce crime.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Anarchists value education and gender equality, though they prefer free education to state curricula; inferred.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Bookchin's defence of reason and secularism goes against teaching creationism as science.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Anarchists distrust coercive law over adults' conduct, though feminists differ; inferred.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Citizenship by blood is a state device linked to ethnic nationalism, which they reject.

minority-language-support.rationale: Federation and local autonomy favour minority cultural life; inferred.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Anarchists oppose coercive law generally but also privilege by faith; no settled view.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Malatesta says it is only through freedom that people learn to be free, which implies tolerance of nonconformity; inferred.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Anarchists see capitalism and colonial expansion as sources of exploitation, so cancelling imposed debts fits; inferred.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Kropotkin: a no-capitalist system implies no government, so political change alone is hollow.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Malatesta rejects elections and assemblies as routes to freedom; inferred.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Malatesta says freedom is the way people learn freedom and rejects dictatorship.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Solidarity and "well-being for all" imply a duty to share, though through mutual aid rather than states; inferred.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Anarchists are anti-militarist and oppose state weapons.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Electing rulers is a defective way of ruling, as Kropotkin argues; inferred.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Central banks are state-capital institutions and anarchists seek to end money or free credit; inferred.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Anarchists reject historic territorial claims and the sanctity of borders.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Kropotkin says private appropriation is neither just nor beneficial, so property is judged by its social effects; they go further to abolish it.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Social anarchists reject the dictatorship of the proletariat and the idea of a socialist state; the label is not universal; inferred.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Social ecology's critique of capitalist ecological destruction favours caution; inferred.

collective-defense.rationale: Military alliances are state blocs that anarchists oppose.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Anarchists reject annexation and domination of peoples by states, though they also reject the sanctity of borders; inferred.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Anarchists want clerical power curbed but not by a stronger state; inferred.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Any head of state is a hierarchy to be abolished.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Kropotkin's federation is free and voluntary, so coercing a region to stay is rejected.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Autonomous federation of communes allows such arrangements, though a larger state is not wanted; inferred.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Hereditary and sacred rule is the domination social anarchists oppose.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Anarchists seek equality of means, so a regressive-leaning tax is not their goal, though they reject taxes too; inferred.

character-from-environment.rationale: Kropotkin says people are shaped by their conditions, so changing conditions improves them.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Anarchists reject sovereign power, whether bound by law or not.

space-expansion.rationale: Not an anarchist concern and adherents have no common view.

mixed-constitution.rationale: It blends forms of state rule, all of which anarchists reject.

leader-cult.rationale: Social anarchists reject fixed leadership and hierarchy.

equal-parenting.rationale: No source addresses family courts; adherents have no common view.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Social anarchists criticise the state socialist claim that class ends under party rule, and see new rulers emerging; inferred.

land-redistribution.rationale: Kropotkin demands expropriation of land from private owners, though to the commune rather than parcelled out to individuals.

refugee-return.rationale: Cosmopolitanism and opposition to expulsion favour return; inferred.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Anarchists reject nationalism and territorial claims by states.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Liberty of conscience and rejection of coercive law rule it out.

women-must-cover.rationale: Anarchists reject coercive law over personal conduct and patriarchal control.

common-currency.rationale: Money is to be abolished in the communist strand, so a bigger currency bloc is not a goal; inferred.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Anarchists reject nationalism and state unification by ancestry.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Self-governing federated groups fit better than ethnic statehood; inferred.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Cosmopolitanism favours equality where people live over founding national states; inferred.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Kropotkin stresses conditions and the economy shape people and society, though mutual aid and ethics also matter; contested.

ban-cartels.rationale: Breaking up monopolies is favoured, but doing it through the state is not; adherents split.

no-bailouts.rationale: Anarchists oppose public money rescuing capital; the aim is abolishing banks and capital, not saving them; inferred.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Bookchin defends majoritarian democracy, while others reject courts and constitutions as state devices; split.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Anarchists want equality but not quota rules via state bodies; inferred.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Kropotkin favours free federation across frontiers, not closed national blocs.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: State trade agreements are not a route to anarchist aims, though better standards are welcome; inferred.

moral-incentives.rationale: Kropotkin's communism relies on voluntary contribution and solidarity rather than wages.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Malatesta wants revolution built from the people up, though insurrectionists favour propaganda of the deed; contested.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Kropotkin and Bakunin oppose class privilege and ending private appropriation includes inherited privilege.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Kropotkin condemns colonial expansion and domination.

patriotic-education.rationale: Malatesta's education by freedom opposes indoctrination into loyalty.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Social anarchists want equality in outcomes but not via state preference schemes; inferred.

public-money-creation.rationale: Money would be abolished or created by free association, not a state body; inferred.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Kropotkin describes capitalism's recurring crises and wars from competition for markets.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Kropotkin condemns imperial expansion and colonial markets.

delink-world-market.rationale: Federation across frontiers is wanted, but autarkic delinking is a national project; inferred.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Kropotkin treats workers as one exploited class under wages; inferred.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: The right to refuse association rests on private property, which anarchists reject, and equality is central.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Anarchists reject constitutional law and courts as state tools, though they value rights in substance; inferred.

minority-veto.rationale: Kropotkin says majority rule is no better than other rule and Malatesta says minorities are sacrificed under universal suffrage.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Inferred from anti-imperialism and rejection of state authority over peoples.

elective-rulers.rationale: Anarchists reject rulers and representative government altogether, whether elected or hereditary.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Inferred: resistance to authority is accepted, though a lawful ruler is not the framing anarchists accept.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Kropotkin and Malatesta reject parliaments and representative government in favour of federated free associations.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Inferred from Kropotkin on mutual aid among animals and the later vegetarianism of many anarchists.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Inferred: many anarchists oppose animal exploitation, though views differ.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Solidarity and mutual aid between equals replace paternalistic duty of the privileged, who should not exist.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Social anarchism calls for direct participation in decision-making and social revolution, against lifestyle withdrawal.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Inferred: anarchists see media and culture as supports for state and capital.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Inferred from the anarchist view that state, church and schools reproduce hierarchy as well as force.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Inferred from the critique of capitalism and imperialism as linked hierarchies.

native-born-offices.rationale: Anarchists reject state offices and nationalism, and are internationalist.

party-own-road.rationale: Inferred: anarchists reject parties and vanguards and any outside direction of a movement.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Inferred: internationalist solidarity and mutual aid favour sharing across borders.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Anarchists oppose state territorial claims and nationalism.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Inferred: anarchists reject rule of any group over another, while supporting indigenous autonomy.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Inferred: strongly anti-fascist, though they distrust constitutions as such.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Anarchists condemn both and also Bolshevism, but object to equating the two or to liberal framings.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Inferred: anarchists reject the claim and see slavery as the central issue of the war.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Inferred from rejection of state-sanctioned glorification of hierarchy and conquest.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Not addressed by the doctrine; adherents are split.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Not addressed by the doctrine; opposition to all domination but split on how services are organised.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Inferred: anarchists are universalist and reject state institutions everywhere, Western or not.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Anarchists reject standing armies and militarism, favouring voluntary militias and federated defence.

paid-care-work.rationale: Inferred split: anarchists favour recognising care labour but oppose the wage system itself.

filial-duty.rationale: Inferred: mutual aid is voluntary solidarity, and anarchists reject imposed duties and family authority.

office-by-exam.rationale: Kropotkin and Malatesta replace bureaucratic officialdom with free federation and recallable delegates, not a credentialed official class.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Inferred: opposes capitalist concentration but rejects giving the state control of industry.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Inferred from Malatesta's view of freedom as solidarity: unions and separations should be free, with no state-imposed fault test.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Malatesta and Bookchin favour delegates who carry out mandates and can be replaced, in direct or confederal democracy.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Kropotkin rejects markets and wages and distributes by need; private savings accounts are the opposite.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Social anarchists favour common ownership and possession by use rather than title, though they reject the nation or state as owner.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Kropotkin rejects representative government and the state's budget power; inferred disagreement, since parliament is not their remedy.

single-official-language.rationale: Inferred: they oppose state coercion in schooling and public life and favour free federation of cultures.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Inferred: they reject property in land and national borders, so the restriction is not their remedy.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Adherents oppose racial inequality but distrust state legal tools and are indifferent to this doctrine; inferred.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Inferred: critiques of capitalist commodification and a society built on acquisition fit the Bookchin and Kropotkin critique.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Inferred from anti-state, anti-militarist principles; they back popular revolt but not state sponsorship.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Inferred from anti-state, anti-war principles and rejection of great-power domination.

corporate-influence.rationale: Anarchists regard state and capital as linked hierarchies, so corporate power over government is an expected product of both.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Anarchists oppose state restrictions in principle but also oppose foreign capital; adherents are split on whether states should regulate NGO funding.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Anarchists reject state natalist programmes and the nation as a unit, and favour open borders; no pronatalist policy is endorsed.

residents-only-property.rationale: Social anarchism rejects exclusion by territory and nation, and abolishes private property in favour of common ownership open to all.

job-guarantee.rationale: The state as employer is rejected; they want wage abolition and workers' self-management rather than a state guarantee.

democratic-peace.rationale: Anarchists see war as a product of states and capitalism, and doubt that spreading state democracy brings peace.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Anarchism holds that there is no general duty to obey the state; Malatesta and Kropotkin reject the legitimacy of governmental law.

non-intervention.rationale: Anarchists support solidarity with revolutions abroad and reject the sovereignty of states, so a strict non-intervention rule is disputed.

industrial-unions.rationale: Anarcho-syndicalism, part of social anarchism, builds industrial unions as organs of the revolution, though craft and local federations also feature.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Anarchists see conspiracy theories about minorities as reaction and oppose nationalism and racism on principle.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Anarchists reject state-conferred marriage as an institution of authority, with free unions instead, though not all adherents press the issue.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Anarchists oppose state secrecy, and the demand for open access matches their critique of state power; they reject the state as the authority.

local-production.rationale: Kropotkin argued for integrating agriculture and industry in local communities, with production near consumption.

informal-organisation.rationale: Malatesta favoured organisation but social anarchists split between informal affinity groups and formal federations; Bookchin criticised informality.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Anarchists reject the sovereignty of every state constitution and courts, and often back international solidarity.

religious-nation.rationale: Anarchists oppose religion as authority and define community by free association, not by shared faith.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Anarchists reject hierarchy between states and peoples, and demand free federation of equals.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Kropotkin favours distribution by need across communes, so regions hoarding revenue is opposed; inferred.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Kropotkin's anarchist communism separates common ownership of land and the means of production from personal possessions, which remain private.

defeat-communism.rationale: Anarchists oppose states, including capitalist ones, and the claim that communism should be defeated by force is rejected, though authoritarian communism is criticised.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Anarchists want services run by workers and communes through common ownership, not for-profit providers.

religion-illusion.rationale: Bakunin's critique treats religion as a consolation for oppression that will fade with freedom; adherents mostly agree, though some stress spirituality.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Kropotkin criticises capitalism, though anarchists differ on whether it created conditions for a better society.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Social anarchists tie liberation of women to abolition of hierarchy and capitalism together.

socialized-care.rationale: Kropotkin proposes communal kitchens and nurseries to free women from domestic drudgery, organised voluntarily rather than by a state.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Anarchists oppose state coercion of language and favour linguistic freedom; inferred.

treaties-binding.rationale: Anarchists reject the authority of states and their treaties, so treaties with a government are not binding lasting promises; inferred.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Social anarchism proposes free federated communes holding property in common, with mutual aid and self-government.

majority-settlement.rationale: Anarchists oppose state steering of populations and nation-building.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Anarchists reject both capitalism and state communism as hierarchies and propose free communism, a third course.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Anarchists reject nation-state and nationalist claims over territory in favour of free federation, but the sources do not discuss land claims; inferred.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Social anarchism is anti-authoritarian and anti-fascist and defends human solidarity; the sources never discuss denial, so this is drawn from those principles.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: The state has no right to police private conduct; Malatesta defines anarchy as liberty and voluntary cooperation without coercion.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Anarchists oppose state coercion and want free association and federation; suppression to preserve order is the state's role they reject.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Anarchists oppose the state and state-backed religion; Malatesta and Kropotkin reject imposing belief by authority, so the state punishing blasphemy is rejected.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Kropotkin and Malatesta oppose exploitation and domination by state and capital, which includes rule of territories for a ruling country's profit.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Anarchists back resistance to invasion and imperial rule but reject religious obligation and religious law as grounds for it; inferred.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Anarchists reject all rulers rather than favouring religious rulers, and reject religious law as a standard of legitimacy; inferred from anti-statism.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Direct decision-making and self-managed free associations are central; Bookchin defends direct democracy in communities.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Social anarchism sees state, capital and hierarchy as linked and to be abolished together, which fits the claim, but the 'intersectional' framing is modern; inferred.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Opposition to hierarchy and coercion favours recognition of people's self-defined identity, though anarchists distrust state law; inferred.

assisted-dying.rationale: Anarchist stress on individual freedom over one's own life favours choice, but the sources do not discuss assisted dying; inferred.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Social anarchism is a left-wing tradition and rejects combining with right-wing ideas; Bookchin defends its collectivist left identity.

alienated-labor.rationale: Kropotkin's critique of wage labour and the capitalist division of work targets the loss of creative control over work, though not in Marx's term.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Anarchists reject cultural essentialism and nationalist exclusion; the sources never discuss Islam, so this is inferred.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: 'No gods, no masters': anarchists reject authority claimed from God and see authority as human and revocable.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Anarchists oppose state religion and clericalism but also oppose coercion over personal conduct, so adherents are split on dress rules; inferred.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Anarchists side with workers against employer power and would back ending hushed-up abuse, though by direct action more than law; inferred.

social-market-economy.rationale: Social anarchism rejects both market capitalism and state management and aims at common ownership, so a regulated market is seen as a half-measure.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Anarchists oppose the state and its standing armies and militarism; defence is to be by an armed people and voluntary federations.

rich-first.rationale: Kropotkin's communism rests on equal sharing and mutual aid, against privilege and accumulation by some.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Anarchists oppose states' rival blocs and militarism but would not endorse any state's neutrality as a goal; inferred.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Hereditary office is a clear case of the hierarchy and rule from above that Kropotkin and Malatesta want abolished.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutualist and cooperative credit fits the stress on voluntary association, though communist anarchists would abolish money and credit altogether; inferred from the family's range.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Opposition to state and capital power makes rejecting creditor-imposed cuts likely, but the sources do not discuss lenders; inferred from anti-capitalism.

property-franchise.rationale: Rejecting hierarchy and privilege rules out wealth-based political rights; Malatesta also holds that the franchise itself is no real freedom.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology traces domination of nature to domination within society, and anarchists oppose all hierarchy, though he was wary of ecofeminism; inferred.

reification.rationale: Critique of commodity relations is Marxist in origin, but anarchists share the view that capitalism makes human relations impersonal and hides that people made them; inferred.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Malatesta argues that formal liberties are empty for the poor while the propertied class holds the means of publicity and assembly.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Anarchists reject state law and judges as instruments of the ruling class, so they do not endorse rule by standing state law, though they favour agreed customs.

racial-franchise.rationale: Universalist solidarity and rejection of nationalism and states mean ethnic limits on participation are rejected.

online-participation.rationale: Direct, participatory decision-making favours any tools that widen participation, though many anarchists prefer face-to-face assemblies; inferred.

open-government-data.rationale: Opposition to secrecy and hierarchy favours open records, but anarchists would abolish the state that holds them; inferred.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Solidarity and opposition to state and religious authority reject legal restrictions on who may marry.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Anarchist solidarity opposes scapegoating and ethnic or religious division of the people.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Bookchin's social anarchism calls for decision-making by face-to-face popular assemblies and direct participation instead of representation; lot-selected citizens' assemblies fit that spirit, but the sources do not discuss sortition, so this is inferred.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Anarchism rejects religious authority and hierarchy, so it favours believers reasoning for themselves over inherited rulings; the sources do not address reinterpreting doctrine, so this is inferred.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Social anarchists hold that wealth accumulation produces domination and that capitalism and the state are linked hierarchies, so concentrated wealth destroys freedom.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Anarchists oppose militaries and conscription, but would defend the right of gay people to take part in any voluntary defence on equal terms; inferred, and the topic is not discussed.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Anarchists oppose state schooling and state-imposed doctrine of any kind, including atheism, though they are broadly anti-clerical and secular.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Anarchists seek to abolish the state's police and prisons and replace them with community and voluntary mechanisms, though Malatesta and others favoured voluntary defence and accepted some form of protection; not all adherents go as far.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Anarchists reject majority rule over minorities and executive government, so they would not accept formal executive power-sharing between communities, but favour federation and free association.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Social anarchists want mutual aid organised through communes and cooperatives, not private charity, which they see as a paternalistic palliative of capitalist inequality.

term-limits.rationale: Anarchists reject rule by elected politicians altogether, so limiting their terms is at most a minor palliative; inferred.

vote-delegation.rationale: Revocable delegation fits anarchist bottom-up federalism with recallable mandates, though anarchists reject representation itself; inferred.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Anarchists focus on abolishing hierarchy rather than on technological or extinction risk, though their ecology strands such as Bookchin's care about survival; inferred.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Anarchism opposes hierarchy and religious authority alike, and rejects patriarchal limits on women, though it does not generally address church office; inferred from equality.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Social anarchism treats the family as a place of authority to be dismantled and demands full equality of the sexes, so the husband holding authority is rejected.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Anarchists reject the nation-state and its borders, so a say for all local residents is inferred, though the sources do not address it.

rent-control.rationale: Anarchists would abolish landlordism through common ownership, not manage it by state caps, so they are split on a reformist measure.

abolish-ip.rationale: Kropotkin holds that the products of collective inheritance belong to all, so exclusive ownership of ideas is rejected, though abolition is not discussed.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Malatesta and the tradition reject militarism, hierarchy and the state, so state-run drilled youth movements are rejected.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Inferred from anti-militarism and opposition to the state; not discussed in the sources.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Inferred from anti-militarism and anti-imperialism; the sources do not address foreign bases directly.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Anarchists distrust state acts but honour victims of state violence; the sources do not discuss this.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Kropotkin argues that all that is produced belongs to those whose work made it, and rejects rent and profit from ownership.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Malatesta accepts violence in defence against oppression, though the tradition favours minimal force.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Social anarchism is internationalist and opposed to nationalism, which it sees as a tool of the state.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Inferred from the anti-essentialist tendency of anarcha-feminism; Bookchin's text does not address it.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Inferred from the anti-hierarchy outlook and anarcha-feminism; not addressed in the sources.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Anarchists reject the nation as an object of sacrifice, though they honour their own martyrs such as the Haymarket victims; inferred.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Malatesta and Kropotkin ground politics in material interests and social struggle, with a secular, anti-clerical outlook.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Anarchists reject nation-states and have no stated view on a diaspora homeland.

culture-before-state.rationale: Anarchists reject the state and the nation, so the question's framing does not apply and is inferred as neutral.

god-not-male.rationale: The tradition is anti-clerical and has no stated view on how God is described, so it is inferred as indifferent.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: The tradition is anti-clerical but supports women's equality; it has no stated view on judging religious texts, so inferred as split.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Social anarchism rejects nationalism and the idea that any national group should control the economy.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Anarchists reject the nation-state and territorial units based on peoples; inferred from its internationalism.

independent-unions.rationale: Social anarchists back unions and syndicates run by workers themselves, independent of both state and party.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Anarchists hold that socialism means workers directly running production, and reject state or party rule in its name.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Kropotkin's anarchist communism puts the means of life in common ownership; here 'public' is read as commons, not state, so the answer is moderate.

second-chamber.rationale: Social anarchism rejects parliament and the state; a second chamber would only add to an institution it wants abolished.

municipal-property.rationale: Common ownership by free communes is central to anarchist communism, and Bookchin's municipalism builds on the community level.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Social anarchism favours federation of free associations with delegates who coordinate while decisions stay with local assemblies, as Bookchin sets out.

family-wage.rationale: Anarchist communists want to abolish the wage system, so they would not endorse a family wage; collectivists and mutualists differ, so this is inferred.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Drug approval speed is not addressed by the sources and adherents have no common view.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Anti-ageing research is not addressed by the sources and adherents have no common view.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Anarchists oppose state control of individuals and finance, though communists want money abolished; inferred.

online-anonymity.rationale: Opposition to state surveillance and authority suggests support for anonymity, but the classical sources predate the question.

person-over-state.rationale: Social anarchists hold that the state and hierarchy subordinate persons, and that freedom and solidarity develop together, so no one is a mere means.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Mainstream social anarchism is materialist and anti-clerical ('no gods, no masters'), though Christian anarchists differ; inferred.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Social anarchism rejects a national legislature and builds power from the bottom up, so no body above the region could hold or revoke its powers.

gm-crops.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology distrusts corporate technology, and the sources do not discuss GM crops; inferred.

dense-cities.rationale: Anarchists favour human-scale, decentralised communities, but the sources do not rank density, so adherents are split.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Social anarchism puts class and universal solidarity over racial divisions and rejects nationalism, so racial political organising is inferred to be divisive.

racial-pride.rationale: Anarchists reject nationalism and see ancestral pride as divisive, though dignity of the oppressed is valued; inferred.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Anarchists oppose state war and militarism but accept defence by popular militias; inferred from this tradition.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Anarchism opposes the nation-state and nationalism and puts voluntary federation above national identity, though it respects cultural and linguistic communities.

communal-electorates.rationale: Anarchists reject electoral representation altogether and would not divide people into religious blocs for it; decisions are made directly and federally.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Inferred from anarchist anti-patriotism: it sees states, not a nation, as the powers that scheme, and rejects patriotic conspiracy framing.

free-public-college.rationale: Kropotkin's communism puts common access to the means of life, education included, ahead of payment; free tuition fits, though anarchists would want it run by communities rather than the state.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Inferred from Bookchin's social ecology, which wants ecological decisions made by communities and rejects market devices, so a state tax on pollution is a poor fit.

future-generations.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology treats the ecological crisis as caused by hierarchy and capitalism and makes protecting the living world central.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Inferred: anarcha-feminism fights gender hierarchy and generally rejects essentialist claims about women's nature, though care and cooperation are valued for everyone.

arms-reduction.rationale: Anarchism is anti-militarist and wants armies abolished; it would agree with reduction, though 'national safety' is not its frame.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from opposition to state power: secret treaties between governments are an instrument of rulers, though anarchists reject state diplomacy itself.

capital-controls.rationale: Inferred: anarchists oppose capitalism but also oppose handing the state more power, so state control of capital flows is not their answer.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Anarchists reject the state and its monopoly of force, and Malatesta favours the armed people and voluntary groups, so disarming all but the state is opposed.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Anarchism is anti-militarist and opposes state wars, and refusal to serve is a longstanding tactic.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Syndicalist and collectivist strands favour union organisation and collective agreements, although communists seek to abolish the wage system; the mainstream supports workers acting as a group.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: State tax credits sustain the wage system and the state, so most adherents favour abolishing both, not topping them up; inferred.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Anarchists reject the state and its legal machinery, so legal fiscal rules for governments are not their concern; inferred.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Anarchists seek to abolish capitalism and the state, not reform trade and debt rules, although many support debt cancellation for poor countries; adherents split.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Anarchists hold that the state must be destroyed and not conquered, in contrast to Marxist seizure of power.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Malatesta argues for the free coexistence of different economic arrangements in an anarchist society, though Kropotkinites hold communism as the aim; the mainstream accepts plural experimentation.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology criticises capitalist commodification of nature, so counting ecosystems as capital to be priced is rejected.

sacred-nation.rationale: Anarchism rejects nationalism and the sacralising of the nation-state as a source of hierarchy.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Debt is seen as a tool of capitalist domination, so relief is favoured, though adherents prefer direct action to state programmes; inferred.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Anarchists criticise imperialism and uneven exploitation by capital and state centres, so the colonial analogy is plausible; inferred.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Kropotkin grounds anarchism in a natural human tendency to mutual aid, though anarchists dispute fixed nature and resist 'not to be redesigned' claims; inferred.

public-service-media.rationale: Anarchists oppose state control of media, though some support commons-based and community media; funding by government is not favoured; inferred.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Anarchists are largely atheist and opposed to organised religion, rejecting religious claims to authority; the claim of a shared spiritual truth is not part of their thought.

farm-price-support.rationale: Social anarchists want land held in common and production run by cooperatives, so they back cooperative credit but oppose state price guarantees; adherents would be split on the combined proposal.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Anarchists reject the state and militarism and its weapons; nuclear arsenals are a tool of state power, so they would not defend keeping them.

workers-own-party.rationale: Malatesta and Kropotkin rejected parties and parliament and called for direct action and self-organisation, so a workers' political party is rejected.

ban-fgm.rationale: Anarchists oppose the practice but also reject state law as the means; adherents split between supporting a legal ban and relying on social action, so a literal agreement with prohibition by law is inferred as split.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Social anarchists oppose inheritance and private ownership of land altogether and support equality of women, so the statement's premise of private land ownership and inheritance does not fit their view.

one-language-many-names.rationale: The question is not addressed by the sources; anarchist federalism respects local culture, but there is no stated position.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Social anarchists would want harm to others prevented through community decision and social ecology rather than property-based lawsuits; Bookchin's social ecology favours collective control, an inference.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Anarchists reject hereditary and official authority and national law-making bodies altogether, so an official advisory role for chiefs is rejected.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Bookchin's social ecology ties ecology to freedom and opposes authoritarian environmentalism, so ranking the environment above liberty is rejected, though they value ecology highly.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Kropotkin and others reject prisons and punishment and the state's legal machinery, so fixed sentences by law are opposed.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Anarchists favour open borders and reject state compulsion over nationality, so a legal requirement on immigrants is opposed.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Anarcho-syndicalists favoured strong union organisation while voluntary association is a core principle; adherents are split on closed shops, inferred.

voter-id.rationale: Anarchists reject the state and elections as the means of rule, so state-imposed voter rules are opposed; inferred from Malatesta.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Anarchists oppose any established state religion and favour free association in belief; inferred from their anti-state stance.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Malatesta and Kropotkin hold that elections and majority rule only change who governs, so a fair vote does not make a government democratic.

premarital-sex.rationale: Social anarchism favours free love and sexual freedom without church or state control; inferred from the movement's libertarian ethos.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Anarchists oppose state control and censorship of communication; shutdowns are an exercise of state power, inferred.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Anarchist communists want common ownership and free provision through federated communes, not a state cash transfer that keeps the wage system; inferred.

women-suffrage.rationale: Anarchists demand full equality for women, but reject voting and office as means, so the statement fits only loosely; inferred.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Anarchism is traditionally atheist and anti-clerical and counts churches as hierarchies that oppress, though the focus is not on women; inferred.

race-social-construct.rationale: Bookchin and other social anarchists reject hierarchy and domination based on ethnicity, so race is seen as an imposed category; inferred.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Anarchists reject state ministries and want gender equality built by social movements and direct action; inferred.

missingStatements.text: Society should be organized as a federation of voluntary associations built from the bottom up, rather than as a state.
missingStatements.rationale: Kropotkin and Malatesta describe free federation of communes and groups as the replacement for hierarchy from centre to periphery.

missingStatements.text: A majority should not be able to bind a minority against its will.
missingStatements.rationale: Kropotkin says majority rule is no better than other rule and Malatesta says minorities are sacrificed under universal suffrage.

notes: Bookchin's municipalism favours majority-vote assemblies, while Kropotkin, Malatesta and consensus advocates distrust majorities; mutualists and collectivists keep exchange and compensation that communists reject. Several answers on state-run measures are inferred from anti-statism.
